name: ogpreview-node
description: A Node.js application that performs a basic SEO audit and displays social media previews based on a website's meta tags.

scripts.check:syntax: node --check server.js && node --check lib/analyze.js && node --check lib/audit.js && node --check lib/image-inspector.js && node --check lib/metadata.js && node --check lib/report.js && node --check lib/safe-fetch.js && node --check lib/site-audit.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/tag-generator.js
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:syntax && pnpm test && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high

author: Muhammad Ali Anjum
